Change has been successfully rebased and submitted as cd9b1c5826323f8035a10513c832cc1a0d351247
Looks good. Why are the meson.build files under packagefiles necessary? Are we changing configs for those subprojects?

The default packageconfigs install their binaries and enable a bunch of features we don't need in libcper.

When those binaries get installed, meson-python fails which I then duked it out with those maintainers:
https://github.com/mesonbuild/meson-python/pull/732

In the end, having a very targeted meson file for json-daccor and json-c lets us have all the weird stuff we need to make a single static library for the python build.
